scientific_integrity: The exact claim concerns a stationary two-time fourth-order position asymmetry, not a new stationary distribution, stationary fourth moment, covariance, finite-sample estimator or entropy-production theorem. The stated analytic identities were checked by an executable symbolic/numerical checker; independent priority and correctness assessment have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Linear harmonic filtering, complete Poisson resets of the Brownian forcing only, stationary dynamics and finite positive reset/relaxation ratio. For the interval between one and the explicit threshold, at least one positive-lag sign reversal is established, without uniqueness or classification elsewhere.
title: A fourth-order arrow of time and lag-sign reversal in a harmonically filtered resetting Brownian bath
